pr_title: Register BlockDelimiters offense with attribute assignment
pr_body:
Update Style/BlockDelimiters to handle attribute assignment.

Fixes #7305 by recognizing that blocks as arguments of assignment methods can safely be mutated from one block delimiter style to the other.

issue_context.title: Style/BlockDelimiters not triggered with attribute assignment
issue_context.body:
Using Style/BlockDelimiters with the default configuration, the following code triggers no offenses:

```
foo.bar = baz.map { |it|
  qux(it)
}
```

## Expected behavior

RuboCop should report "Style/BlockDelimiters: Avoid using {...} for multi-line blocks."

## Actual behavior

RuboCop reports nothing.

## Steps to reproduce the problem

Create a file with the following contents and run RuboCop on it:

```
# frozen_string_literal: true

foo.bar = baz.map { |it|
  qux(it)
}

puts foo
```

RuboCop will report no offenses.

## RuboCop version

```
$ rubocop -V
0.74.0 (using Parser 2.6.3.0, running on ruby 2.6.3 x86_64-linux)
```

review_comments: This test case is good. OTOH, `EnforcedStyle: 'semantic'`, `EnforcedStyle: 'always_braces'` and  method chained `EnforcedStyle: braces_for_chaining` should not be warned. Could you add these test cases and pass them?
